# Support Resources

Need assistance with **BoardPort — Linaro Releases**, finding an archived release, or verifying an image hash?
Check out the available support resources below.

---

## 1. Documentation

Before filing an issue, please review the documentation available in this repository:

- Main catalog and board table: [README.md](../README.md) / [README_RU.md](../README_RU.md)
- AI & Agent Guidelines: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) / [AGENTS_RU.md](../AGENTS_RU.md)
- GitHub Releases: Inspect existing published boards and tags in [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/boardport/linaro-releases/releases)

## 2. Issues & Requests

- Check existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/boardport/linaro-releases/issues) to see if your board or release has already been discussed.
- To request a new board/release mirror or report a broken link/hash, use the provided [Issue Templates](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/).

## 3. Direct Contact

For inquiries, maintainer questions, or collaboration within the BoardPort ecosystem:

- **Email**: **BoardPort Team <boardport@proton.me>**
